name: voice-command
description: Optional speech input and output through a localhost-only MCP wrapper.

interface.shortDescription: Talk with an AI through Voice-Command speech I/O.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Voice-Command MCP wrapper and concise operating guidance. Speech recognition is local; current edge-tts speech output sends response text to Microsoft's online service. Voice changes the input and output channel only and grants no new tool privileges.
defaultPrompt: Use Voice Command for a short spoken conversation.
Check whether my local voice listener is ready.
Explain how to enable Voice Command in this client.
